jobs.title: Product Owner (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
*Securian Financial Group’s internal position title is Product Owner Consultant.

Position Summary:

As Product Owner for Partner Data Exchange (PDX), you will shape and execute the vision for secure, scalable data integration between Securian, EBS clients, and partners. You will be empowered and accountable to drive outcomes through execution by collaborating with business, technology, and external stakeholders to modernize data exchange, streamline data flows, improve operational efficiency, and deliver outcomes aligned to strategic priorities. This position requires someone who is passionate about understanding our customers, who can bring creative and bold new ideas to life, and who will deliver superior results consistently.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:
- In partnership with business and technology owners, create a compelling product vision for Partner Data Exchange and develop and execute a product roadmap focused on measurable outcomes, regularly sharing progress with stakeholders and the team.
- Define product OKRs, monitor and report on business and technology metrics/outcomes.
- Collaborate across Employee Benefits Solutions, Enterprise Technology, Operations, and external partners to elicit, analyze, and understand needs, constraints, and risks, aligning with organizational strategy and priorities.
- Collaborates with cross-functional teams, technical partners and product owners within your functional area.
- Engage and collaborate with teams and stakeholders to create and manage Agile artifacts (e.g., Product Roadmap, Backlog) and information needed for prioritization decision-making; regularly assess features, costs, and impact to determine whether and when to proceed.
- Transform business objectives and product strategies, together with the needs of partners, into specific actionable requirements for product agile teams.
- Drive day-to-day product management decisions by prioritizing and maintaining the sprint backlog for assigned products, balancing the requirements of stakeholders and partners.
- Cultivate and maintain effective relationships with all stakeholders and partners, helping the business create requirements for changes and improvements.

Qualifications:
-  3+ years as a product owner with the ability to demonstrate realized business value and outcomes.
- Strategic thinker, analytical and results driven.
- Leadership skills to gain credibility, garner respect, guide the creation of a self-organizing team and be assertive with business priorities and opposing viewpoints while adhering to Agile concepts and principles.
- Working knowledge of Agile practices. Understands the fundamentals of iterative development, incremental delivery, backlog management, burn down metrics, velocity and task definition.
- Strong communication, facilitation and interpersonal skills to connect and engage team, facilitate discussion, advocate for team and negotiate with business/corporate areas, mentor/coach team members, and resolve conflict.
- Solid analytical skills, creative problem-solving skills, and high attention to detail.
- Ability to work with minimal direction, flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities and schedules, handle multiple issues simultaneously, and manage stressful situations.
- Strong knowledge of technical concepts and architectural principles to drive scalable solutions.

#LI-Hybrid **This position will have a hybrid working arrangement, working in-office for a minimum of 3 days a week.**

Securian Financial believes in hybrid work as an integral part of our culture. Associates get the benefit of working both virtually and in our offices. If you’re in a commutable distance (90 minutes) you’ll join us 3 days each week in our offices to collaborate and build relationships. Our policy allows flexibility for the reality of business and personal schedules.

Preferred Skills:
Business Acumen, End User Support, Internal Communications, Problem Solving, Quality Analysis, Requirements Gathering, Scrum, User Story
The estimated base pay range for this job is:

$89,000.00 - $164,300.00
Pay may vary depending on job-related factors and individual experience, skills, knowledge, etc. More information on base pay and incentive pay (if applicable) can be discussed with a member of the Securian Financial Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Product Owner (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
*At Securian, the internal job title is Product Owner Consultant*

Position Summary

Help shape the future of ServiceNow as an enterprise platform.
Securian is looking for a ServiceNow Platform Product Owner who can connect established enterprise strategy with platform execution. You will work across business and technology organizations to identify where ServiceNow can create the greatest value, build a transparent product roadmap, prioritize ServiceNow demand within established enterprise priorities, and guide an agile platform team toward measurable outcomes.

The ServiceNow Platform Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the business and technology value of Securian's enterprise ServiceNow platform. This role owns the ServiceNow product vision, roadmap, and backlog within established enterprise strategy, capability priorities, governance standards, and investment guardrails. The Product Owner translates stakeholder needs and approved priorities into executable work and makes product-level prioritization decisions that balance business value, user experience, platform health, risk, scalability, and long-term sustainability.

Working closely with business leaders, the IT Services Manager, ServiceNow platform engineering, architecture, IT service management, governance, and Enterprise Technology partners, the Product Owner will shape product demand, define measurable product outcomes, and ensure ServiceNow capabilities are delivered in alignment with established enterprise strategy and platform standards. The role serves as the primary bridge between strategic direction and the agile delivery team, ensuring the team is solving the highest-value problems rather than simply delivering requested features.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means Securian has a clear and transparent ServiceNow product roadmap aligned to established enterprise priorities; roadmap and backlog decisions maximize measurable value within approved capacity and investment guardrails; stakeholders understand what the platform team is delivering and why; platform capabilities are adopted and achieve intended product outcomes; and the platform remains scalable, reliable, maintainable, and positioned for future growth.

Role Scope & Decision Rights
The Product Owner is accountable for the ServiceNow product vision, roadmap, backlog, product-level prioritization, and product outcomes within the strategic direction and guardrails established by the IT Services Manager and appropriate enterprise leadership. The role informs and recommends, but does not own, enterprise IT Services strategy, enterprise capability governance, or enterprise investment decisions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap
- Own and continuously evolve the ServiceNow product vision and multi-quarter roadmap within established enterprise strategy, capability priorities, governance standards, and investment guardrails.

- Translate established enterprise strategies, capability priorities, and desired business outcomes into product themes, roadmap sequencing, epics, features, and actionable delivery priorities; provide evidence-based recommendations to inform investment decisions.

- Evaluate new and existing ServiceNow capabilities and recommend where the platform should invest, enhance, standardize, simplify, or retire capabilities based on value, strategic alignment, platform health, and stakeholder needs.

- Balance strategic initiatives, operational needs, regulatory requirements, technical debt, lifecycle needs, and platform modernization in roadmap decisions.

Enterprise Demand & Prioritization
- Apply established enterprise demand governance and prioritization criteria to evaluate ServiceNow requests based on business value, strategic alignment, customer impact, risk, cost, capacity, and implementation complexity.

- Facilitate prioritization and trade-off decisions when demand exceeds available platform capacity.

- Partner with stakeholders to challenge requests when configuration, process change, existing capabilities, reuse, or retirement may produce a better outcome than new development.

- Maintain transparency into what is being prioritized, why it is being prioritized, and what outcomes are expected.

Value Realization & Product Outcomes
- Define measurable product outcomes and success measures for roadmap initiatives and platform capabilities, aligned to enterprise capability outcomes.

- Monitor product and platform indicators such as adoption, user experience, automation, cycle time, reliability, platform health, and realized business value.

- Evaluate whether delivered capabilities achieve intended outcomes and use results to adjust future roadmap priorities.

- Communicate platform performance, roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and evidence-based investment recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

Platform Governance & Sustainability
- Partner with the ServiceNow Platform Architect and engineering team to ensure solutions align with architecture, security, data, integration, and platform governance standards.

- Balance customization with configuration and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities to protect long-term maintainability and upgradeability.

- Participate in platform governance and design decision forums and incorporate technical debt, upgrades, lifecycle management, and platform health into product priorities.

- Operationalize and adhere to established platform principles and guardrails that promote scalability, enterprise reuse, and sustainable product growth; recommend changes when product evidence identifies a need.

Stakeholder & Enterprise Leadership
- Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on how ServiceNow capabilities can address enterprise opportunities and operational challenges.

- Build alignment across competing stakeholder priorities and facilitate difficult product trade-off decisions.

- Partner closely with capability and process owners, Enterprise Architecture, cybersecurity, risk, engineering, operations, and other enterprise stakeholders.

- Communicate complex technical and product decisions in clear business terms and create transparency into roadmap decisions, priorities, dependencies, and outcomes.

Agile Product Ownership & Delivery
- Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring work is aligned to the platform roadmap and expected business outcomes.

- Translate business outcomes into themes, epics, features, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria for technology teams.

- Lead or participate in planning, refinement, story mapping, reviews, and other agile product management activities.

- Partner with engineering and architecture throughout solution design and delivery, and accept completed work based on agreed outcomes and acceptance criteria.

- Ensure operational issues, platform health, technical debt, and lifecycle needs are appropriately reflected in product priorities rather than treated as separate support work.

Product Ownership & Decision Rights
Required Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, platform management, technology delivery, or a related discipline.

- 3+ years working with ServiceNow in a product, platform, architecture, delivery, or process leadership capacity.

- Demonstrated experience owning or significantly influencing a technology product or platform roadmap and backlog.

- Experience prioritizing competing enterprise demands and translating business objectives into measurable technology outcomes.

- Strong understanding of Agile product management and modern product development practices.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations without direct authority.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and technical delivery teams.

- Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills in complex or ambiguous situations.

Preferred Qualifications
- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

- ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) or another relevant ServiceNow certification.

- Experience with one or more major ServiceNow product areas such as ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, IRM, or App Engine.

- Experience operating within a ServiceNow platform governance or Center of Excellence / Center of Excellence and Innovation model.

- Working knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture, integration patterns, data models, and upgrade or lifecycle considerations.

- ITIL 4 Foundation or advanced ITIL certification.

- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or comparable product-management certification.

- Experience working with diverse technology teams in a complex, highly regulated enterprise environment.

- Comfort presenting to large audiences and facilitating discussions with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.

Securian Financial believes in hybrid work as an integral part of our culture. Associates get the benefit of working both virtually and in our offices. If you’re in a commutable distance (90 minutes), you’ll join us 3 days each week in our offices to collaborate and build relationships. Our policy allows flexibility for the reality of business and personal schedules.

Preferred Skills:
Agile Methodology, Change Management, Product Roadmap, Product Strategies, Requirements Analysis, ServiceNow Platform, Software Implementations

*Securian’s internal job title is Product Consultant*

Product Owner, Associate Productivity Solutions

As the Product Owner for Associate Productivity Solutions, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of enterprise productivity, collaboration, and communication technologies that enable associates to work more effectively.

In this role, you will be accountable for maximizing the value of our productivity platform portfolio by aligning business needs, technology capabilities, and user experience goals. Working closely with business stakeholders, the AI Center of Excellence, AI Innovation Corner, engineering teams, infrastructure partners, and vendors, you will shape product direction, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that improve associate productivity, strengthen governance, and accelerate adoption of enterprise collaboration tools.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, data-driven decision making, and Agile product management to ensure solutions deliver measurable business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities
- Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to business priorities and associate needs.

- Partner with stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and vendor organizations to align priorities and outcomes.

- Translate business objectives into actionable product requirements, features, and delivery plans.

- Establish and track product OKRs, KPIs, and adoption metrics to measure value realization and continuous improvement.

- Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities maximize business value and user outcomes. Facilitate backlog refinement, release planning, and Agile delivery activities.

- Lead prioritization decisions by evaluating business value, user impact, cost, risk, and technical considerations.

- Drive adoption and effective use of productivity technologies through ongoing engagement, feedback, and education strategies.

- Ensure platform governance, compliance, and operational sustainability while enabling innovation and experimentation.

- Assess market trends, emerging technologies, and AI capabilities to identify opportunities that improve associate productivity and experience.

In-Scope Solutions
Enterprise productivity and collaboration solutions used across the organization, including:
- Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, OneNote)

- AI productivity platforms for associates: (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and related AI-enabled capabilities)

- Collaboration and content management platforms (Box, Smartsheet, and future enterprise collaboration solutions)

What Success Looks Like
- Strong stakeholder partnerships and effective prioritization of initiatives and investments.

- A clear product roadmap aligned to organizational priorities and emerging technology opportunities.

- Increased associate adoption and satisfaction with productivity tools.

- Delivery of measured business value through productivity, efficiency, and collaboration improvements.

- Well-governed, scalable, and secure enterprise collaboration platforms.

Required Qualifications
- Ability to connect technology investments to business outcomes and user needs.

- Ability to evaluate opportunities, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to maximize product value.

- Ability to foster strong partnerships and teamwork across cross-functional and distributed teams.

- Ability to build alignment across business and technology partners and effectively influence decision-making.

- Ability to communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders and diverse audiences.

- Ability to use metrics, insights, and feedback to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.

- Ability to enable innovation while ensuring appropriate governance, compliance, and operational sustainability.

- Ability to apply Agile product management practices, including backlog management, release planning, iterative delivery, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications
- 1+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst, Product Consultant, or similar product-focused role, delivering measurable business outcomes.

- Experience managing enterprise productivity, collaboration, or digital workplace platforms, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

- Familiarity with AI-enabled workplace technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and emerging productivity solutions.

- Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.

- Knowledge of platform governance, information architecture, content management, and platform lifecycle practices.
